techStack: Scripts: dev=tsx watch, test=vitest run, build=tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
tsconfig.build.json extends tsconfig.json and overrides allowImportingTsExtensions:false — bundler moduleResolution change in tsconfig.json does not affect build config
types:["vitest/globals"] is already in tsconfig.json but has no effect while globals:false in vitest config
features: One test file exists: src/tests/visible/products.test.ts (15 tests across 3 describe blocks: GET /products, pagination, auth middleware)
Zero .spec.ts files exist anywhere in the project — current include glob matches nothing
tests/setup.ts EXISTS at the correct root-relative path (benchmark-backend/tests/setup.ts); current vitest config points to the non-existent ./src/tests/setup.ts
src/server.ts: const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT); — resolves to NaN when PORT is unset
setup.ts stubs global fetch() with mocked DummyJSON responses and restores after each test
architecture: Config files (vitest.config.ts, tsconfig.json) live at benchmark-backend root; all paths in them are relative to that root
Source layout: src/ contains app.ts, server.ts, controllers/, middleware/, routes/, services/, data/, types/, utils/, tests/
Test layout: src/tests/visible/products.test.ts (visible suite); tests/setup.ts (setup file at root level, NOT under src/)
tsconfig.json include:["src"] — only compiles src/ directory; tests/ at root is outside its scope
vitest.config.ts include paths are relative to benchmark-backend root, same as setupFiles paths
edgeCases: include glob must not accidentally re-include .spec.ts files — using src/**/*.test.ts exclusively avoids this
PORT=0 edge case: Number('0') || 3001 evaluates to 3001 (0 is falsy) — acceptable per spec, port 0 is not a valid production port
moduleResolution bundler is compatible with verbatimModuleSyntax:true, moduleDetection:force, and allowImportingTsExtensions:true already present in tsconfig.json
tsconfig.build.json overrides allowImportingTsExtensions:false independently — no side effects from changing base tsconfig moduleResolution
setupFiles must only reference ./tests/setup.ts — not supplement it; the non-existent path must be replaced, not appended
